clips.send: Song ocean-going ship. Big, strong and built for the open sea. Song shipbuilding led the world: ships were large, carried heavy loads and resisted storms. A Song ship found in Quanzhou Bay in 1974 had a hull divided into 13 compartments. What survives is about 24 m (79 ft) long, the length of a tennis court. Big ships could carry hundreds of people and sailed to Southeast Asia, South Asia, Arabia and East Africa, a sea voyage of more than 6,000 miles (10,000 km). Three “big” things about Song ships: big hull, big load, big voyages.
